verdicts.typography: Flawless Swiss-style execution. Heading scale is authoritative, mono uppercase micro-labels are perfectly disciplined, tracking is tight, line-height is generous, and the red accent on 'this?' and 'the integration' provides exacting hierarchy without noise. No orphans, no cramped text.
verdicts.color: Publication-grade minimalist discipline. Strictly one accent red (#E53935 or similar) against near-black and white. WCAG AA contrast is clearly met. The 'THIS SYSTEM' column's 2px red left rule and red header text is the perfect restrained distinction. No off-brand colors anywhere.
verdicts.layout: Excellent alignment and whitespace rhythm throughout. The max-w container is consistent, hairline grids are intact with no double borders. One minor nitpick: in d4-analysis, card #5 ('The ethical tightrope is unique') appears to have its bottom content slightly clipped or the card height is not perfectly matching its neighbors, breaking the strict grid uniformity expected in Swiss design.
verdicts.components: Flawless component quality. The matrix table is a standout: legible marks (solid red for core, dashed for partial), sticky first column works perfectly (proven in d9-scrolled), and the final column is correctly highlighted. Accordion affordances are clear with chevrons and red dots. Sticky nav, stat strip, and footer all perform exactly as specified.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless mobile and dark-mode execution. Mobile layout maintains integrity at 390px with no overflow or clipped text; the wide matrix table handles horizontal scrolling correctly with a sticky first column for context. Dark-mode palette is consistent with high contrast across all components, including the complex data table.

layout: Ensure all cards in the analysis grid (d4-analysis) share identical heights so that bottom borders align into a perfect horizontal line, preserving the strict grid integrity.
